BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Labor & Commerce (originally sponsored by Senators Conway, Keiser, Hasegawa, Saldaña, and Kuderer)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to noncompetition agreements; and adding a new section to chapter 49.44 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 49.44 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any contract that restrains an hourly employee from engaging in a lawful profession, trade, or business of any kind is against public policy and is void and unenforceable to the extent that it restrains a person from engaging in a lawful profession, trade, or business.
